test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Joey completed the school project in 15 days. How many days will Tim take to complete the same work if he is 25% more efficient than Joey?
solution:
**Given:**

Joey completed the school project in 15 days.

Tim is 25% more efficient than Joey.

**Concept:**

Efficiency and time are inversely proportional.

If a person is more efficient, they will take less time to complete the same work.
